## Checklist

- [ ] `just lint` and `just test` pass
- [ ] README, docstrings, `docs/` and `CHANGELOG.md` (under `[Unreleased]`) are updated
- [ ] If the `--questions` document changed: the snapshot is regenerated and reviewed, and `QUESTIONS_FORMAT_VERSION` is raised if a field changed meaning or was removed
- [ ] If prompts changed: tried in a real terminal, not only through the tests
